findings.source_issue: The source presents p iff not-not-p as an unconditional logical equivalence and uses it to infer a positive p from a contradiction under not-p. That last step is classically valid but not generally intuitionistically valid.
findings.minimal_treatment: Qualify the positive indirect proof as classical reasoning and disclose the scope, retaining the source formulas.
